notes.title: Our new game Hope for Village is ready!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The big day is soon and we are ready for it!
Hope for Village will be live on 4 April and we have a 40% big launch discount, valid for the first week!

So, don’t miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1005630/Hope_For_Village/

Also, don’t miss our new release trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OlyIO2hbkX0
As always, thank you for your love and support.
Cheers, Cloaz Studio!
